title: Standard user logs in and lands on product catalog page
preconditions: App is accessible; standard_user account exists
description: Validates that a standard user with correct credentials is authenticated and redirected to the product catalog page with the expected page title.

steps.expectedState: Login form is visible with username, password fields and Login button

steps.action: Enter username from TEST_USERNAME env var
Enter password from TEST_PASSWORD env var

expectedResult: URL changes to /inventory.html; page title is 'Swag Labs'; product catalog grid is visible with at least one product

dataConditions.input: TEST_USERNAME=standard_user, TEST_PASSWORD=secret_sauce (loaded from process.env — never hardcoded in test)
dataConditions.state: User is logged out; app is on the login page
dataConditions.constraints: Credentials must match an active standard_user

title: User sees error when correct username but wrong password is entered
preconditions: App is accessible; login page is open
description: Validates that the system rejects a login attempt with a valid username paired with an incorrect password and surfaces the appropriate error message.
expectedResult: User remains on the login page; error message 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' is visible; both fields show error indicator

dataConditions.state: User is logged out; app is on the login page
dataConditions.constraints: Password must not match the actual TEST_PASSWORD

title: User sees error when non-existent username is entered with valid password
preconditions: App is accessible; login page is open
description: Validates that the system rejects a login attempt using an unrecognised username, even when paired with a valid password, and displays the credential mismatch error.
expectedResult: User remains on the login page; error message 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' is visible; error indicator shown on both fields

dataConditions.input: username='invalid_user_xyz' (non-existent username), password from TEST_PASSWORD env var
dataConditions.state: User is logged out; app is on the login page
dataConditions.constraints: Username must not match any registered account

title: Locked user sees lockout error message on login attempt
preconditions: App is accessible; locked_out_user account exists
description: Validates that a locked user account is explicitly refused with a distinct lockout error message — not the generic credentials mismatch message used for invalid credentials.
expectedResult: User remains on the login page; error message 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' is visible; message is distinct from the generic credentials error; error indicator shown on both fields

dataConditions.input: username='locked_out_user' (from users.json), password from TEST_PASSWORD env var
dataConditions.state: User is logged out; locked_out_user account is locked
dataConditions.constraints: Account lock state must be permanent (not session-based)

title: User sees validation error when username field is submitted empty
preconditions: App is accessible; login page is open
description: Validates that submitting the login form with the username field blank produces a specific 'username required' validation message.

steps.expectedState: Login form is visible; both fields are empty

steps.action: Enter TEST_PASSWORD in the password field

expectedResult: User remains on the login page; error message 'Epic sadface: Username is required' is visible; username field highlighted with error indicator

dataConditions.input: username='' (empty), password from TEST_PASSWORD env var
dataConditions.state: User is logged out; app is on the login page
dataConditions.constraints: No whitespace-only username should pass validation

title: User sees validation error when password field is submitted empty
preconditions: App is accessible; login page is open
description: Validates that submitting the login form with the password field blank produces a specific 'password required' validation message.

steps.expectedState: Login form is visible; both fields are empty

expectedResult: User remains on the login page; error message 'Epic sadface: Password is required' is visible; password field highlighted with error indicator

dataConditions.input: username from TEST_USERNAME env var, password='' (empty)
dataConditions.state: User is logged out; app is on the login page
dataConditions.constraints: No whitespace-only password should bypass check

title: User sees validation error when both fields are empty on login attempt
preconditions: App is accessible; login page is open
description: Validates that clicking Login with both fields blank shows the username-required error (username is validated first before password).

steps.expectedState: Login form is visible; both fields are empty

steps.action: Leave both username and password fields empty

expectedResult: User remains on the login page; error message 'Epic sadface: Username is required' is visible (username validated before password); username field highlighted with error indicator

dataConditions.state: User is logged out; app is on the login page
dataConditions.constraints: Form must not submit with both fields empty
